microthemes.name: HBM & advanced packaging
microthemes.inclusion_predicate: Document a specific HBM product or advanced-package integration service and identify which role the business actually supplies.
microthemes.exclusion_predicate: Do not pool memory makers, foundries, packagers, equipment vendors and accelerator customers as equivalent HBM producers.
microthemes.next_evidence_gate: D03 remains deferred: role-separated evidence and existing semiconductor slice countersign precede any identity split; each role has independent measurement eligibility.

microthemes.name: GPUs & merchant accelerators
microthemes.inclusion_predicate: Identify a marketed or shipped merchant GPU/accelerator product with an issuer and stage, rather than the customer's ownership of a GPU cluster.
microthemes.exclusion_predicate: Exclude CPU-only products, foundry service and cloud customers from the merchant-accelerator producer role.
microthemes.next_evidence_gate: Resolve each product generation at the evidence clock; deduplicate diversified issuers across their product families.

microthemes.name: AI cluster interconnect silicon
microthemes.inclusion_predicate: Require a named silicon component whose function is moving data within or between compute nodes.
microthemes.exclusion_predicate: Optical modules, cable, switches sold as systems, and cloud network operation do not automatically prove the silicon-design role.
microthemes.next_evidence_gate: D04 optical/component scope and semiconductor parity remain held; record the product boundary instead of changing this ID.

microthemes.name: Custom ASIC accelerators
microthemes.inclusion_predicate: Require evidence of custom compute silicon design or supply, with development versus delivered stages explicit.
microthemes.exclusion_predicate: A chip being an ASIC is insufficient: solar inverters and generic switching ASICs are not custom AI accelerators.
microthemes.next_evidence_gate: A particular hyperscaler customer, production volume or revenue share needs an exact product/customer receipt, not rumor.

microthemes.name: Conventional DRAM (non-HBM)
microthemes.inclusion_predicate: Require non-HBM DRAM products or manufacturing; distinguish the component from its module packaging and target market.
microthemes.exclusion_predicate: Exclude HBM from the non-HBM role and exclude merely buying DIMMs or server memory.
microthemes.next_evidence_gate: Qualify actual product availability and issuer identity; keep DDR/LPDDR facets, not independent factors inferred from labels.

microthemes.name: NAND & enterprise storage
microthemes.inclusion_predicate: Require NAND or enterprise solid-state-storage products and state whether the issuer makes the memory, integrates drives, or provides a narrower component.
microthemes.exclusion_predicate: Exclude HDD-only, generic cloud storage service, and a former parent's historical flash business after separation.
microthemes.next_evidence_gate: D05 rejects a mechanical NAND/SSD split; first establish product roles, current corporate perimeter and purpose-specific measurement.

microthemes.name: Lithography tools
microthemes.inclusion_predicate: Require semiconductor lithographic exposure/patterning tools or directly documented relevant systems.
microthemes.exclusion_predicate: Do not infer semiconductor lithography from camera optics, flat-panel-display equipment, or fab ownership alone.
microthemes.next_evidence_gate: Check semiconductor versus display segment and vendor availability; thin issuer count is not permission to pad the cohort.

microthemes.name: Etch & deposition equipment
microthemes.inclusion_predicate: Require named wafer-process etch or deposition equipment sold by the business.
microthemes.exclusion_predicate: Exclude vacuum valves, precursor chemicals, wafer customers and metrology-only activity from the complete-process-tool role.
microthemes.next_evidence_gate: Separate tool-level revenue from the wider supplier and preserve overlaps where a supplier genuinely offers both tool classes.

microthemes.name: Process metrology & inspection
microthemes.inclusion_predicate: Require semiconductor process inspection or metrology systems, with application and object identified.
microthemes.exclusion_predicate: Do not merge general industrial machine vision or clinical imaging into semiconductor metrology because they all use sensors.
microthemes.next_evidence_gate: Establish process-specific products and corporate control; avoid treating several tools from one issuer as independent observations.

microthemes.name: Wafer-fab subsystems & components
microthemes.inclusion_predicate: Require a component supplied to wafer-fab equipment or fab process systems, not just generic industrial capability.
microthemes.exclusion_predicate: Exclude whole process-tool makers unless the named business separately supplies the relevant subsystem; exclude unconfirmed customer rumors.
microthemes.next_evidence_gate: Obtain product/use evidence and a qualifying fab role for each candidate; commodity industrial sales alone are insufficient.

microthemes.name: Liquid cooling & thermal management
microthemes.inclusion_predicate: Require a liquid-cooling or high-density thermal product or integration service tied to relevant compute infrastructure.
microthemes.exclusion_predicate: Exclude the data-center operator as a cooler manufacturer and do not equate ordinary room air conditioning with rack liquid cooling.
microthemes.next_evidence_gate: Record subsidiary control and commercial product stage; keep cooling capacity and issuer economic materiality separate.

microthemes.name: HV transformers & switchgear
microthemes.inclusion_predicate: Require specific high-voltage transformer or switching equipment activities.
microthemes.exclusion_predicate: A UPS, inverter or low-voltage power supply is not automatically high-voltage transmission/distribution equipment.
microthemes.next_evidence_gate: D06 splitting remains deferred; capture voltage/application and product roles before forming any homogeneous measurement cohort.

microthemes.name: UPS & power conversion
microthemes.inclusion_predicate: Require a named UPS or relevant conversion product and identify its application.
microthemes.exclusion_predicate: Exclude grid transmission ownership, generic electrical contracting and transformer-only activity from the UPS product role.
microthemes.next_evidence_gate: Separate actual catalog products from planned plant capacity; record data-center versus broader applications.

microthemes.name: Reactor technology
microthemes.inclusion_predicate: Require ownership/development/supply of reactor technology, not simply a utility's purchase or operation of a plant.
microthemes.exclusion_predicate: Design approval, a memorandum, site selection and a financed operating reactor are distinct and must not be conflated.
microthemes.next_evidence_gate: Keep technology developers visible semantically while commercial operating exposure remains unproven where no operating receipt exists.

microthemes.name: Nuclear components
microthemes.inclusion_predicate: Require named components with nuclear end-use evidence.
microthemes.exclusion_predicate: Do not infer nuclear qualification from ordinary industrial pumps or general steel production.
microthemes.next_evidence_gate: Verify applicable nuclear program, supplier role, qualification and delivery stage without exposing restricted contract bodies.

microthemes.name: Fuel cycle
microthemes.inclusion_predicate: Identify the exact fuel-cycle stage and distinguish current operations from licensed or planned expansion.
microthemes.exclusion_predicate: Mining, conversion and enrichment are not interchangeable; an operator buying fuel is not a fuel supplier.
microthemes.next_evidence_gate: D07 retains the combined ID while stage-specific cohorts and nuclear-owner boundaries are separately reviewed.

microthemes.name: Grid distribution automation
microthemes.inclusion_predicate: Require products or software that observe or control electricity distribution networks.
microthemes.exclusion_predicate: Exclude generic cloud analytics, pure transmission cable manufacturing and unrelated enterprise software.
microthemes.next_evidence_gate: Name utility-facing functions and actual products; a software announcement does not quantify recurring revenue.

microthemes.name: Transmission & HVDC cabling

microthemes.name: Missiles, munitions and effects

microthemes.name: Aerospace components and aftermarket

microthemes.name: Military space and satellite communications

microthemes.name: Machine vision

microthemes.name: Industrial controls and motion control

microthemes.name: Surgical robotics systems

microthemes.name: GLP-1 incretin therapies

microthemes.name: Oral GLP-1 formulations

microthemes.name: Cardiorenal and metabolic indications

microthemes.exclusion_predicate: The same molecule across indications is not several independent companies or demand streams that may be summed.

microthemes.name: Fill-finish and drug-delivery devices

microthemes.exclusion_predicate: Do not equate empty cartridges, injector devices, sterile filling and peptide synthesis.

microthemes.name: Launch services
